chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: The tasks resource represents a single card on a project board. Every task belongs to exactly one project and has a status, priority, and optional assignee.

chunks.heading: POST /v1/tasks
chunks.text:
curl -X POST https://api.lighthouse.example/v1/tasks \
  -d project_id=prj_44a1 -d title="Ship the release" \
  -d assignee_id=usr_1c88

chunks.heading: PATCH /v1/tasks/{task_id}
chunks.text:
curl -X PATCH https://api.lighthouse.example/v1/tasks/tsk_9f2a \
  -d status=done
# any subset of task fields may be included in the body

chunks.heading: Rate limiting headers
chunks.text:
Every API response includes:
X-RateLimit-Limit: 600
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 542
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1735689600
